attempts.summary: Installed a cron.d job on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Made the script executable (it was previously non-executable), verified manual execution appends to the log, then performed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot id and healthy state, issued a safe systemctl reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot id changed, and verified crond, the cron.d entry, script permissions, and the log all survived and remained functional post-reboot.
